Swiss Army Bench 0.0.17: Install and Update read the package list fresh.

- **Install an extension, or Update, right after a release:** uv's cache could still hold the list of versions
  from before the release, and say there is no such version: the app then started again without the change.
  Install, Remove and Update now ask uv to read Swiss Army Bench's own entry in the package index again
  (`--refresh-package swissarmybench`), so the version you are on, or the one offered, is always found.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.17), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
